limits: Only the assigned synthetic case, incomplete archive and twelve anonymous packets informed substantive judgments. No real-world outcome was measured; new means local archive novelty.

All 44 raw openings have direct outcome/decision links and specific proposed discriminators; these scores do not establish efficacy. Inference labels denote evidence-informed proposals, not proven effects.

Fit assesses the bounded action: protected paper/replay checks and consented trials preserve C1-C4. Unknown schedule feasibility, adoption or the two-hour success target is not itself a hard-constraint violation. Existing desk coordination needs verification before broader rollout.

F07 versus F03 equivalence remains uncertain: cyclic exchange may instantiate ordinary global reassignment. F04, F05 and F08 count distinct comparative interaction predictions, not renamed baseline components.

No new family appears only in Distill. P001 adds an unsupported equipment assertion; its causal proposals remain retained. Generic 'conditional' wording in P005/P009 does not identify any explicitly relaxed premise.
Failure to find a schedule or cycle is weaker than demonstrating its nonexistence; several packet rejection rules should therefore remain local to the attempted search.
Some textual cues expose combination comparisons or full-versus-partial capability framing; blinding notes record these cues without seeking method labels.
